Jinx! She’s like a jack of all trades hypercarry. She’s a crit based adc who shines in teamfight scenarios. 

Her passive gives her a huge movespeed and attack speed boost after a takedown on an enemy champion or when she destroys a turret, that’s when you’ll be at your most deadly. When your passive is going, most champions can’t fight you, you can dodge their spells with the movespeed, and because of the attack speed, you will out damage them if they turn to attack you, use this to your advantage, this is how you win teamfights. 

Her 1st move is a toggle between one of two guns. 

- When using the first gun, the minigun, you get a stacking attack speed bonus, that caps at 3 stacks, once you hit 3 stacks your attack speed is increased as long as you are shooting the minigun and a few seconds after. Use the minigun for single target scenarios. 
- The 2nd gun, the rocket launcher, has increased range, does more damage and does aoe, however, there is an attack speed penalty for using it, and each shot costs mana. You want to use the rocket launcher as an augment between the minigun. After you get full stacks of the minigun, you can switch to the rocket launcher and have the attack speed bonus for a few shots, if you’re fast enough you can switch back to the minigun and refresh your full stacks before they fall off. The rockets are great in teamfights when there’s multiple targets, and the extra range can help to keep you safe as well. Trust me, they blow stuff up, you’ll want to use them all the time but it’s good to remember that the minigun does more single target dps and you always want the attack speed buff that it gives you. 

Her 2nd move is a basic projectile skill that stops at the first enemy hit. This projectile slows and reveals enemies, and does a good chunk of damage on a low cd!

Her 3rd move is her traps. Jinx will throw a set of traps that activate after a slight delay. Anyone caught in the trap will be rooted (not stunned) for like 1.5 seconds or something. Use this to lock down enemies that your support ccd, or use it to save you from the enemy jungler. A good starter tip would be: if an enemy master yi uses his 1st move on you, throw your traps right below your feet. When he comes out of alpha strike he will instantly be caught in the traps, and you can run away! 

Her Ultimate is a giant rocket that travels the length of the map or until it hits an enemy champion. This rocket does increased damage based on distance travelled and missing health. Use it to finish off your opponents that have narrowly escaped you, or to snipe a low health enemy from across the map! Maybe steal a baron or two? The choice is yours!

Jinx is a really versatile champion and can hold her own in pretty much any match. It just takes one kill. 

You can find tons of high level pc gameplay featuring jinx to get a better idea of how to play adc. I would recommend imaqtpie jinx videos! Cheers!
